fx_evidence.attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates.
fx_evidence.use_terms: Federal Reserve Board website information is public domain unless otherwise indicated. No exception marked for this series. Attribution requested. No logo or seal used.
fx_evidence.limitations: SGD per USD noon New York buying rate for cable transfers. Reference rate, not executable spot or FX total return. Latest vintage, not point-in-time revision-safe data. FX return uses inverse quote: USD per SGD. No FX hedge, rate differential or conversion fee model.
fx_evidence.dependence_note: Joint listed-ETF/FX covariance fitted on common weekly dates. Weekly property dependence is assumed through its user-set equity shock correlation; property/FX correlation is induced, not separately estimated from quarterly property data. Daily FX is NY noon while ETF NAV is close, so observations are not synchronous.

invariance_evidence.assumption: Raw weekly log returns are modeled iid by the Gaussian-mixture default; this assumption has not been established.
invariance_evidence.scope: Descriptive split-distribution and lag diagnostics, inspired by Meucci (2005), pp.103-105. No p-values, multiple-test pass label or economic coverage claim. Low linear autocorrelation alone does not imply independence; squared-return dependence can remain. No data cleaning, parameter adjustment or model selection is performed.

prior_weekly_shape.scope: Before entropy-pooling views. Development-selected mixture shape, not fitted to historical skewness or kurtosis. Sample shape estimates are noisy descriptive statistics, not population truths.
